tools.name: call2me_profile
tools.description: Safe summary of the connected Call2Me account: email, name, account type. NEVER returns the API key. Use when the user asks which account they are connected to.

tools.name: call2me_list_agents
tools.description: Lists the voice assistants on the account. Use when the user wants to see their assistants, or needs to pick one for another operation.

tools.name: call2me_get_agent
tools.description: Full settings for a single assistant: language, voice, system prompt, model.

tools.name: call2me_list_calls
tools.description: Lists past calls: direction, duration, status, number. Pass agent_id to restrict to one assistant.

tools.name: call2me_get_call
tools.description: Details of a single call: start and end, duration, status, cost.

tools.name: call2me_get_call_transcript
tools.description: Returns the conversation transcript in vCon format — who said what, with timestamps. Use when the user asks what was said on a call.

tools.name: call2me_list_phone_numbers
tools.description: Lists the phone numbers on the account and which assistant each one is bound to.

tools.name: call2me_list_campaigns
tools.description: Lists bulk calling campaigns: status, target count, progress.

tools.name: call2me_list_schedules
tools.description: Lists scheduled calls: when, which number, which assistant.

tools.name: call2me_get_wallet
tools.description: Current account balance in USD, the same wallet that calls and numbers draw on.

tools.name: call2me_list_interpreters
tools.description: Lists the live interpreters on the account: name, language pair, bound number. An interpreter connects two people who each speak their own language, translating in real time.

tools.name: call2me_get_interpreter
tools.description: Settings for a single interpreter: language pair, voice, transparency mode, phone number, browser session link.

tools.name: call2me_list_interpreter_calls
tools.description: Lists sessions run through an interpreter: duration, languages, status.

tools.name: call2me_get_interpreter_web_status
tools.description: Shows who is currently connected to the interpreter browser session.

tools.name: call2me_list_allowed_countries
tools.description: Countries where a phone number can be purchased. Use before searching numbers to see which countries are open.

tools.name: call2me_search_numbers
tools.description: Lists purchasable phone numbers in a country. DOES NOT BUY — it only shows them. The country code is required; do not guess it, ask the user or call call2me_list_allowed_countries first.

tools.name: call2me_get_pricing
tools.description: Per-minute call rates and number prices.

tools.name: call2me_create_agent
tools.description: Creates a new voice assistant. Do not call it unless the user asks explicitly; do not invent fields such as name and language — ask.

tools.name: call2me_update_agent
tools.description: Changes an existing assistant. Send only the fields the user named explicitly.

tools.name: call2me_create_schedule
tools.description: Schedules a call for a given time. This WILL produce a REAL call — the target number is dialled when the time comes. agent_id, phone_number and scheduled_at are REQUIRED; never guess any of them, ask the user if anything is missing.

tools.name: call2me_create_interpreter
tools.description: Creates a new live interpreter. name, source language and target language are REQUIRED — never guess any of them, ask the user.

tools.name: call2me_update_interpreter
tools.description: Changes an existing interpreter. Send only the fields the user named explicitly.

tools.name: call2me_enable_interpreter_web
tools.description: Opens or closes the browser session link for an interpreter. Does NOT place a phone call.

tools.name: call2me_create_interpreter_passcode
tools.description: Mints a single-use join passcode for the browser session.

tools.name: call2me_bind_number
tools.description: Binds a phone number to an assistant, which then answers calls to that number. Replaces any existing binding.

tools.name: call2me_checkout_number
tools.description: Creates a checkout link for buying a number. DOES NOT BUY and DOES NOT CHARGE — the user confirms on the payment screen themselves. Use this path when the balance is insufficient.

tools.name: call2me_create_voice_session
tools.description: Opens a browser voice session and returns connection details. Does NOT place a phone call.

tools.name: call2me_make_outbound_call
tools.description: Places a REAL phone call: the target number is dialled IMMEDIATELY and charged. Cannot be undone. Call this ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a call to be placed. agent_id and to_number are REQUIRED — never guess either one, never infer it from earlier conversation and never assign a default. tools.name: call2me_end_call
tools.description: Cuts off a call in progress IMMEDIATELY. Cannot be undone — the conversation ends.

tools.name: call2me_delete_agent
tools.description: PERMANENTLY deletes an assistant. Cannot be undone. If it is unclear which assistant is meant, NEVER guess — ask the user.

tools.name: call2me_start_interpreter_call
tools.description: Places a REAL phone call: the target number is dialled IMMEDIATELY, both sides are connected through live translation, and the call is charged. Cannot be undone. Call this ONLY when the user explicitly asks. interpreter_id and target_number are REQUIRED — never guess either one.

tools.name: call2me_purchase_number
tools.description: BUYS a phone number: the balance IS CHARGED and monthly rent starts. Cannot be undone. Call this ONLY when the user explicitly asks to buy and has picked the number themselves. tools.name: call2me_release_number
tools.description: PERMANENTLY releases a phone number: it leaves the account, may be reassigned to someone else, and cannot be recovered. Incoming calls stop.

tools.name: call2me_unbind_number
tools.description: Removes the number's assistant binding; calls to it are no longer answered. The number stays on the account.

tools.name: call2me_delete_interpreter
tools.description: PERMANENTLY deletes an interpreter. Cannot be undone. If it is unclear which one is meant, NEVER guess — ask the user.

tools.name: call2me_end_interpreter_web
tools.description: Cuts off the browser session in progress IMMEDIATELY. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: call2me_cancel_schedule
tools.description: Cancels a scheduled call. Cannot be undone.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "call2me_make_outbound_call" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: call2me_get_call_transcript · Private data: call2me_profile, call2me_get_wallet · Public sink: call2me_profile, call2me_update_agent, call2me_update_interpreter · Destructive: call2me_get_call_transcript, call2me_list_interpreter_calls, call2me_delete_agent, call2me_delete_interpreter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: call2me_get_call_transcript · Private data: call2me_profile, call2me_get_wallet · Public sink: call2me_profile, call2me_update_agent, call2me_update_interpreter · Destructive: call2me_get_call_transcript, call2me_list_interpreter_calls, call2me_delete_agent, call2me_delete_interpreter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
